title: Gate 2FA: a stolen passphrase without the authenticator
caption: The gate sits between unwrapping the root key and deriving any node key: a correct passphrase plus a wrong code leaves one parked, zeroise-on-drop root key and an empty hot set, expiring in 120 seconds — no node credential is ever reachable. crates/brokerd/src/state.rs (unlock, PendingGateUnlock, gate_verify), crates/brokerd/src/ops.rs (dispatch), crates/brokerd/src/protocol.rs (wire error shapes).
